risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (compression, timing, bearings) not visible externally.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine running/starting, or a compression test result.

risks.risk: Engine may not match a specific, identifiable vehicle make/model/year, which drives most of its value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code sticker, casting number, or VIN plate confirming exact vehicle fitment.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified used engine, lowest bracket for its type

risks.risk: Missing ancillary parts (sensors, wiring harness, turbo if applicable) that affect completeness.
risks.proof: Wide-angle photos from multiple sides showing full engine with all harnesses/connectors.

risks.risk: Mileage/age of engine unknown, affecting expected remaining life.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or engine service history.

risks.risk: Stated guarantee may not be honorable (no shop name, address, or contact verified).
risks.proof: Photo of shop signage, receipt book, or verifiable business registration.
risks.if_unproven: guarantee treated as having no value in pricing

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/casting number or any VIN-linked plate to confirm exact vehicle fitment.
Video of the engine running (cold start) to demonstrate it is functional.
Multiple angle photos showing the full engine including rear/bellhousing side and wiring harness completeness.
Photo or document proving the '2 months guarantee' (e.g., shop receipt, warranty card, shop signage with contact details).
response.reason: The photo shows a used engine but gives no vehicle make/model or engine code, which is essential to set even a worst-case price since engine values vary drastically by application; a clear code/casting number shot is needed before pricing.
